ui.aTermuxStyleKeyRowEscTabCtrlArrows: A Termux-style key row (Esc, Tab, Ctrl, arrows and more) shown above the keyboard while typing in the terminal or editor. Choose when it appears in each orientation.
ui.addsJCodeSLogcatOutputIncludingProotA: Adds JCode's logcat output — including proot and the Linux environment running under it, which is where most of the detail about toolchains, extensions and language servers ends up. Only JCode's own entries are readable; another app's never are.
ui.addsAnExtDevTabToTheRightPanel: Adds an "Ext Dev" tab to the right panel (inspector, manifest validator, live log) for debugging an unsigned .jext or .vsix. Importing one does not need this; signed marketplace extensions are unaffected.
ui.allowJCodeToInstallAppsThenTapUpdateA: Allow JCode to install apps, then tap Update again.
ui.android12KillsAnAppSForkedProcessesOn: Android 12+ kills an app's forked processes once they pass the cap — 32 by default. proot, the shell and everything under it count, so a long build or coding-agent session goes over it and the terminal dies while JCode keeps running. Run these from a computer with the device connected (or from this device's own adb) to lift it; it survives reboots but has to be redone after a factory reset.
ui.androidCapsHowManyProcessesAnAppMayFo: Android caps how many processes an app may fork and kills the rest — which takes the whole Linux environment down mid-command. Raising the cap needs one adb command; JCode cannot set it itself.
ui.androidStoppedTheLinuxEnvironmentBack: Android stopped the Linux environment (background process limit).
ui.appVersionAndUpdatesFromGitHubRelease: App version and updates from GitHub releases.
ui.appendF1F12ChipsToTheRowWhileA: Append F1–F12 chips to the row while a terminal is focused (htop, midnight commander, and other TUIs use them).
ui.appendTheStackTraceWhenTheAppCrashesS: Append the stack trace when the app crashes, so the log covers the failure itself and not just what led up to it.
ui.automaticallyCloseTerminalsLeftIdleAt: Automatically close terminals left idle at the prompt (no running program) to free their process tree and memory. Terminals running a command are never auto-closed.
ui.backUpTheWholeLinuxEnvironment25GB: Back up the whole Linux environment (~2.5 GB) to a .tar.gz you can restore here or on another device.
ui.buildLogsAndToolOutputWillAppearHere: Build logs and tool output will appear here.
ui.chooseHowTheFileExplorerIsLaidOutAppl: Choose how the file explorer is laid out. Applies to the current edit scope.
ui.chooseWhichBuiltInCommandsThePaletteO: Choose which built-in commands the palette offers. Context-dependent commands only appear when their view is focused (e.g. Go to Line needs an open editor).
ui.colorPaletteAppliedAcrossTheApp: Color palette applied across the app.
ui.colorCodeEditorFileTabsLongPressAFile: Color-code editor file tabs. Long-press a file tab to set its color by hand; colors are remembered in the project's .jcode. A project can override this default.
ui.completeUbuntuSetupBeforeInstallingJa: Complete Ubuntu setup before installing Java.
ui.completeUbuntuSetupFirstExistingInsta: Complete Ubuntu setup first. Existing installations and Java data will not be reset.
ui.configurationErrorsAndOnSaveSyntaxChe: Configuration errors and on-save syntax checks appear here.
ui.configureThisProjectThenCreateIt: Configure this project, then create it.
ui.defaultFontSizeAndWordWrapForTheCode: Default font size and word wrap for the code editor. A workspace or project can override the font size on its own settings tab.
ui.deletingAFileOrFolderOrDiscardingACha: Deleting a file or folder, or discarding a change in Source Control, keeps a copy that can be restored. Turn this off to delete immediately and permanently.
ui.devServerDidnTStartInTimeCheckThe: Dev server didn't start in time; check the run terminals.
ui.developmentToolsCheckingWhenAKitIsIns: Development tools: checking when a Kit is installed
ui.dragAFingerOnTheEditorToMoveThe: Drag a finger on the editor to move the text cursor (the view scrolls to follow) instead of scrolling. Long-press still selects text. Applies app-wide.
ui.dragTheDividerOrUseThisKeyboardAccess: Drag the divider or use this keyboard-accessible slider. The panel always leaves room for the editor.
ui.environmentSetupProotDistroBootstrapA: Environment setup: proot, distro bootstrap, and the final smoke test. Install, switch between, or remove environments from the setup page.
ui.excludeFilesAndFoldersAtTheProjectRoo: Exclude files and folders at the project root in the Explorer. "By-injected" comes from each project's .gitignore, kept in sync by the Source Control extension. Excluded entries are greyed out by default, or hidden from the tree entirely.
ui.exportedIntoEveryTerminalAndBuildRunS: Exported into every terminal and Build & Run session (e.g. API keys, GOPRIVATE, JAVA_OPTS). Applied to newly opened terminals.
ui.fallBackToTheAppWideDefault: Fall back to the app-wide default
ui.filesRemainRecoverableFromTrashRegist: Files remain recoverable from Trash. Registered project roots cannot be removed here.
ui.finishDistroSetupFirstThenOpenTheTerm: Finish distro setup first, then open the terminal again.
ui.finishEnvironmentSetupBeforeOpeningTh: Finish environment setup before opening the terminal.
ui.folderExportSupportsLocalFoldersOnly: Folder export supports local folders only
ui.goodDefaultsAre24Or8SpacesDepending: Good defaults are 2, 4, or 8 spaces depending on the project.
ui.howJCodeDrawsTheUIEditorAndTerminal: How JCode draws the UI, editor, and terminal.
ui.howEditorAndTerminalTabsBehaveApplies: How editor and terminal tabs behave. Applies app-wide.
ui.howLongAToolchainInstallSDKLanguageSe: How long a toolchain install (SDK, language server, debugger) may run before it's cancelled. Increase it for large SDKs like the Android SDK on a slow connection.
ui.howTheRenderedMarkdownPreviewLaysOut: How the rendered Markdown preview lays out.
ui.howTouchInputBehavesInTheEditorApplie: How touch input behaves in the editor. Applies app-wide.
ui.iconSetUsedForFilesAndFoldersInThe: Icon set used for files and folders in the Explorer, tabs and search results.
ui.iconSetUsedForTheAppSOwnToolbars: Icon set used for the app's own toolbars, tabs and menus.
ui.ifTheProjectIsUnderGitYouCanRestore: If the project is under git, you can restore it there.
ui.installJavaBasicPluginFromTheSuiCodeP: Install Java Basic Plugin from the sui-code Plugin Library for single-file running. Java IDE Kit adds language services and debugging. No JCode plugin market is used.
ui.installTheBasicLanguagePluginFromPlug: Install the basic language plugin from Plugin Center. IDE Kit Center adds intelligence, debugging and project tools. Environment installation is independent of both package formats.
ui.installingNowGivesYouTheNewVersionWit: Installing now gives you the new version with nothing in it. This one is left as it is, so you can free up space and update again instead.
ui.itWasAddedToThisWorkspaceOpenItNow: It was added to this workspace. Open it now, or keep it in the workspace to open later?
ui.jCodeSOwnFolderAndFileGlyphsFromThe: JCode's own folder and file glyphs, from the UI icon set.
ui.jCodeSOwnInEditorBrowserWithDevTools: JCode's own in-editor browser, with DevTools
ui.keepEnabledForTheEditorSurfaceButLetU: Keep enabled for the editor surface, but let users disable it for long coding sessions.
ui.keepTheLinuxRuntimeLeanByStoppingWork: Keep the Linux runtime lean by stopping work you're done with. Each terminal, run, and debug session holds a proot process tree in memory.
ui.keepTheAppClearOfTheCameraNotchOr: Keep the app clear of the camera notch or punch-hole. When off, the app draws into the cutout area for a full-screen layout.
ui.kitCancellationRequestedSetupStaysOpe: Kit cancellation requested. Setup stays open until the current package operation finishes safely.
ui.layOutTheAppInsideTheCutoutSSafe: Lay out the app inside the cutout's safe area instead of drawing behind it.
ui.lettersDigitsAndUnderscoreOnlyCanTSta: Letters, digits and underscore only; can't start with a digit
ui.modernSitesCanRenderBlankOrBrokenOnTh: Modern sites can render blank or broken on this engine. Install the latest Android System WebView, then select it under Developer options → WebView implementation. Some devices lock the provider; JCode then keeps using the ROM's engine.
ui.monospaceTypefacesForTheCodeEditorAnd: Monospace typefaces for the code editor and the terminal. More fonts can be added by extensions.
ui.movingToADifferentlyNamedBuildWriteTh: Moving to a differently-named build? Write the environment, projects, extensions and settings to the shared JCode folder, then import them from the new install.

ui.refreshPackageListsAndUpgradeInstalle: Refresh package lists and upgrade installed packages (apt-get update && upgrade). Runs in the Setup terminal — can be slow and use data.
ui.remapTheHardwareVolumeButtonsToEditor: Remap the hardware volume buttons to editor/terminal actions. "System Default" keeps normal volume control. Pane actions (arrows, scroll) act on whichever editor or terminal is focused; hold to repeat arrows and scrolling.
ui.removeOnlyClearsTheRecentListFilesSta: Remove only clears the recent list; files stay intact.
ui.removesTheOnEditorAndTerminalTabsToAv: Removes the × on editor and terminal tabs to avoid accidental closes. Close a tab from its long-press menu instead.
ui.renderTheUIEditorAndTerminalOnTheGPU: Render the UI, editor, and terminal on the GPU. Turn off only to troubleshoot rendering glitches on this device — software rendering is much slower. Takes effect the next time the app starts.
ui.reopenTheLastWorkspaceProjectAndEdito: Reopen the last workspace, project, and editor tabs — including unsaved changes — when JCode starts. Missing files are skipped.
ui.saveYourAppPreferencesToAFileThenRest: Save your app preferences to a file, then restore them here or on another device. (Theme and editor settings live in the workspace config.)
ui.showTheAndroidAppChooserEachTime: Show the Android app chooser each time
ui.startADebugSessionToSeeItsConsoleOutp: Start a debug session to see its console output here.
ui.subShellsOpenInTheirOwnTab: Sub-shells open in their own tab
ui.systemFollowsYourDeviceSLightDarkSett: System follows your device's light/dark setting.

ui.theChromiumEngineBehindJCodeSBuiltInB: The Chromium engine behind JCode's built-in browser and web previews. It is the device's WebView provider — a system component JCode can read but not choose; when it can't be updated, JCode falls back to the ROM's engine.
ui.theBarAcrossTheTopOfTheWorkbenchWith: The bar across the top of the workbench, with the project name and quick actions.
ui.theBarAtTheBottomOfTheWorkbenchShowin: The bar at the bottom of the workbench showing branch, distro, and cursor position.

ui.theBrowserUsedWhenYouOpenARunningDev: The browser used when you open a running dev server (Build & Run) or tap a URL in the terminal. A local project can override this on its Project settings tab.
ui.theButtonBesideRunHidingItLeavesTheTe: The button beside Run. Hiding it leaves the terminal reachable from the right drawer.
ui.theMostAnEditorOrTerminalTabWidensBef: The most an editor or terminal tab widens before its name is shortened in the middle (e.g. "build.gradle.kts" → "build.g…kts").
ui.theRootFolderIsPermanentManageProject: The root folder is permanent. Manage project names through Project management.
ui.theseControlsWriteBackToYAMLAndUpdate: These controls write back to YAML and update the open editor immediately.
ui.theseSettingsPreserveTheSharedFolderJ: These settings preserve the shared folder .jcode configuration and apply unless a Project overrides them.
ui.theseSettingsSaveToTheProjectJcodeAnd: These settings save to the project .jcode and only affect the selected local project.
ui.toolsForBuildingAndTestingJCodeExtens: Tools for building and testing JCode extensions.
ui.treeShowsTheWholeProjectHierarchyList: Tree shows the whole project hierarchy; List is a one-folder file manager with breadcrumbs.
ui.tryAShorterOrDifferentTermLikeFontOr: Try a shorter or different term, like “font” or “theme”.
ui.uILanguageResourcesNoLanguageEnvironm: UI language resources · no language environment required
ui.unavailableThisMilestoneRequiresALinu: Unavailable: this milestone requires a Linux ARM64 environment.
ui.updatedKitAvailableReviewItsSignedDep: Updated Kit available. Review its signed dependency plan to adopt the v0.5 workflow.
ui.whenClosingAProjectOrWorkspaceWithARu: When closing a project or workspace with a running terminal command, an active Build & Run, or a live debug session, ask first before stopping them.
ui.whenYouStartAnInteractiveShellBashZsh: When you start an interactive shell (bash, zsh, …) inside a terminal, open it in a temporary tab that closes when the sub-shell exits, returning to the parent — like a new console window. Scripts and piped shells stay in the current tab.
ui.whenYouSwipeJCodeOffTheAndroidRecents: When you swipe JCode off the Android recents screen, stop the Linux runtime (terminals, runs, VMs) and exit completely instead of leaving it running in the background.
ui.whereDeletedFilesGoBeforeTheyAreGoneC: Where deleted files go before they are gone. Covers Delete in the Explorer and Discard in Source Control; the Trash itself opens from the Explorer toolbar.
ui.whichFormatterTheEditorUsesBuiltInIsR: Which formatter the editor uses. Built-in is rule-based; formatter extensions appear here once installed.
ui.wrapLongLinesToTheEditorWidthInsteadO: Wrap long lines to the editor width instead of scrolling horizontally.
ui.writesAppEventsToALogFileOnThis: Writes app events to a log file on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere — you choose when to export it. File paths are replaced with placeholders so the log is safe to share.
ui.previewTruncatedTheWholeFileIsRestore: … preview truncated; the whole file is restored intact.
